name: print-social-photo-with-cream-paper-event-cards-and-blue-blob-dates
title: Upcoming Events with Paper Cards and Blob Dates
whatItIs: A portrait flyer over a cropped photo of a person in a knit top with a thin outline frame, a giant white serif title 'UPCOMING EVENTS' and four cream paper cards listing events, each with a sky-blue blob holding the time and date, alternating left and right.
whatItMeans: Organic blue blobs and textured paper cards feel friendly and crafted, and alternating sides gives a list rhythm.
techniques: Blob shapes carrying dates alternating sides
Cream paper texture cards over a photo
Thin outline frame inside the canvas
Bold date and light description in each card

vocabulary.definition: An organic shape holding a date and time.
A card with a paper-like texture.
Items placed left then right down a page.
